notes: Scope: apps/dashboard, the app CONTRIBUTING.md:26 points to for local setup (root README's Manual Setup also has one-liners for apps/status-page `pnpm -w dev:status-page` and the marketing site apps/web `pnpm -w dev:web`). `pnpm -w dx` runs turbo env -> migrate -> seed: copies packages/db/.env.example to packages/db/.env, applies Drizzle migrations to the libSQL server, seeds workspace/user ping@openstatus.dev, monitors and a status page. After dx the docs say to STOP the libSQL server from their step 2 (apps/dashboard/README.md:53-55) because `pnpm -w dev:dashboard` starts its own on :8080 (port conflict otherwise). Login via magic link printed to the dashboard terminal. Requirements: Node >=26.2 (dashboard README; devbox.json and CI pin 26.8.1), pnpm (packageManager pnpm@12.3.4, pnpm-lock.yaml), Turso CLI; Bun optional. Without Turso CLI, `node scripts/dev-stack.mjs up` does the libSQL/dx/dev steps. Tinybird, apps/server and the Go checker are optional. readmeCommands: the root README's recommended Docker path (builds production images of all services; its `open http://localhost:3002` lines omitted); the README's dashboard manual setup just links to apps/dashboard/README.md.
